name: Stitch N Print, Inc
old_description: Stitch N Print has been servicing Oklahoma City and the surrounding area since 1974.
about:
Stitch N Print, Inc. has operated in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma since its founding in 1974. The company has served the local market and surrounding areas for decades, building a reputation for custom decorated apparel and textile products.

The shop provides a range of decoration services including screen printing (up to seven colors on items such as shirts, jackets, hats, bags, tablecloths, towels, notebooks, and umbrellas), embroidery on similar substrates, team uniform assembly with trim and piping, direct-to-garment printing, sewn banners, vinyl lettering and numbering, and tackle twill custom lettering and numbering. The facility handles both small and large orders, though specific capacity figures are not published.

Stitch N Print serves businesses, schools, sports teams, and organizations throughout the Oklahoma City metro area that need branded apparel, promotional items, and team uniforms. Customers include local companies seeking logoed workwear, athletic programs requiring numbered jerseys, and events needing custom banners.

The company emphasizes on-time delivery and competitive pricing, stating it will “get your job done on time and for less” while maintaining quality and complete customer satisfaction.
